tools.name: list_photo_specs
tools.description: The passport, visa, ID card and other ID photo specs fotosize has checked against official sources, with an id for get_photo_spec. Filter by country code. can_make_here is false where the photo must be taken at the office or fotosize does not make it.

tools.name: get_photo_spec
tools.description: One ID photo spec: print size in mm, head size and how it is measured, allowed backgrounds and whether the background may be changed, online pixel size and file limit where there is one, who takes the photo, the official source and the date it was checked, and a link to make the photo in the browser
